overall_goal: Fry the aubergine in sunflower oil and season it with salt and black pepper

goals.description: Prepare the frying pan with sunflower oil
goals.rationale: The person retrieves the frying pan and the sunflower oil, placing the pan on the hob and pouring the oil into it.

goals.description: Add the aubergine to the pan and start stirring
goals.rationale: The person transfers the sliced aubergine from the chopping board into the frying pan, picks up spilled pieces, and begins stirring.

goals.description: Season the aubergine with salt and black pepper
goals.rationale: The person adds salt and grinds black pepper over the aubergine, adjusting the grinder as needed.

goals.description: Stir the aubergine and return spilled chunks to the pan
goals.rationale: The person stirs the seasoned aubergine, carefully picking up and returning any chunks that spilled onto the hob back into the pan.

goals.description: Press and stir the aubergine to cook evenly
goals.rationale: The person uses the wooden spoon to press down on the aubergine to release oil and continues stirring to ensure even cooking.

goals.description: Adjust the heat and continue frying the aubergine
goals.rationale: The person adjusts the hob heat, cleans their fingers, and persistently stirs and presses the aubergine to prevent it from burning.

goals.description: Perform final stirring of the aubergine
goals.rationale: The person continues to stir the aubergine in the frying pan to ensure it is well cooked and does not stick.
